explication: Sortable is a browser-side JavaScript library for dragging items within and between lists, then reporting the resulting changes through callbacks and events. The main workflow is a consumer creating a Sortable instance on a DOM list; Sortable handles pointer or drag events, moves items, and uses animation and event-dispatch helpers. Optional capabilities include auto-scroll, multi-drag, swapping, and spill handling. The README documents these features and entry points; some core and plugin wiring is unsampled, so uncertain links are omitted or marked unverified.
